description: This file defines the 'sock_addr' union which encapsulates different socket address structures for IPv4, IPv6, and UNIX domain sockets, along with various inline and external functions to access and manipulate socket address data.

methods.name: int sock_addr_get_family(const sock_addr * saddr)
methods.description: Returns the address family of the socket address by accessing the 'sa_family' field of the 'plain' sockaddr structure.

methods.name: sock_addr_get_port
methods.description: Returns the port number associated with the socket address.

methods.name: sock_addr_is_addr_wildcard
methods.description: Checks if the socket address is a wildcard address.

methods.name: sock_addr_is_family_eq
methods.description: Compares two socket addresses to see if they belong to the same address family.

methods.name: sock_addr_is_port_eq
methods.description: Checks if two socket addresses have the same port number.

methods.name: sock_addr_is_addr_eq
methods.description: Checks if two socket addresses are equal.

methods.name: sock_addr_is_addr_eq_bits
methods.description: Checks if the bits of two socket addresses are equal up to a specified number of bits.

methods.name: sock_addr_set_port
methods.description: Sets the port number for a socket address.

methods.name: sock_addr_assign
methods.description: Assigns a new address to a socket address structure with specified family, port, and address data.

methods.name: sock_addr_inet_pton
methods.description: Converts an IPv4 or IPv6 address from text to binary form and stores it in the socket address.

methods.name: sock_addr_inet_ntop
methods.description: Converts a socket address from binary to text form.

methods.name: sock_addr_inet_ntop_copy_buffer
methods.description: Copies the textual representation of a socket address into a buffer.

methods.name: sock_addr_inet_ntop_append_buffer
methods.description: Appends the textual representation of a socket address to a buffer.

methods.name: sock_addr_stringify_append_buffer
methods.description: Appends a stringified version of the socket address to a buffer.

methods.name: sock_addr_nameinfo_append_buffer
methods.description: Appends hostname or service information of the socket address to a buffer, possibly resolving the name.

methods.name: sock_addr_from_buffer_hints_numeric
methods.description: Initializes a socket address from a buffer with hints for numeric address and port.

methods.name: sock_addr_from_str_hints
methods.description: Parses a string to initialize a socket address with specified family and hints.

methods.name: sock_addr_from_str_numeric
methods.description: Parses a numeric address string to initialize a socket address.
